title: Some categorical remarks on coarse subspaces of coarse spaces
summary: In this paper, we provide a categorical framework for understanding coarse subspaces of coarse spaces. First, we introduce the notion of a controlled total relation between coarse spaces and show that the category whose morphisms are closeness classes of controlled total relations is isomorphic to the conventional category of coarse spaces defined using closeness classes of controlled maps.
